Teaching

At Bauhaus-University Weimar (2016 – today)

The results from my design and planning projects from 2016 – today are documented on the Online Learning Platform OTP (category Urban) :: https://otp.uni-weimar.de/design-studio-results/?filter=urban&pid=3&pg=1

At Bauhaus-University Weimar (2009 – 2012 and 2016)

The following collection contains the teaching documentation that show results from various seminars during my time as interim professor at the Chair of Computer Science in Architecture, as well as documentations of teaching-collaborations of my Junior-Professorship for Computationa Architecture at Bauhaus-University Weimar from 2016.

At ETH Zurich (2012 – 2016)

In collaboration with Estefania Tapias and Gerhard Schmitt I have developed the course New Methods in Urban Analysis and Simulation at the Chair of Information Architecture, ETH Zurich. The following documentation booklets show the results of the past seminars.
